text:
mia: quick sync — we got three field asks about private deploy upgrades and customer-managed networking. need to lock scope for the next milestone (M2). do we go full rolling upgrade or phased components?
sanjay: leaning phased. upgrade order: control plane -> installer agent -> runtime. minimizes cross-dependency risks.
elaine: +1 phased. must include KMS/HSM path in M2 (several FSI customers demanded CMK). otherwise we won't get signoff.
raj: networking note: customers want to bring-your-own-NAT + flexible IP allocation per-tenant. that changes installer UX (we need explicit network-profile step).
jamie: ops constraints — zero-downtime requirement is realistic only for model serving pods; control plane can have short maintenance window (<= 5m). we need clear SLOs in the release doc.
mia: agreed. propose launch criteria: (1) successful rolling upgrade on staging with >2x load, (2) 3 pilot customers run full upgrade without manual rollback, (3) KMS integration end-to-end, (4) network-profile docs and installer flags. any objections?
els: (ops-bot): automated smoke tests triggered on canary deploy: 2201234567-canary-smoke -> passed
elaine: no objections but add automated verification for KV cache migration (we saw cache invalidation bugs before).
sanjay: action: add cache-migration verifier to e2e. owner: sanjay. ETA: 2 weeks.
raj: action: prototype network-profile CLI: --network-profile <json> and manifest fields. owner: raj. ETA: 10 days.
jamie: action: define SLO doc + rollback checklist. I'll own with eng-sre. ETA: 1 week.
customer-success: flag: customer A requires air-gapped packaging (offline installer + checksum signing) — they won't accept online-only flow. need installer bundle for airgap in M2 or M3?
mia: airgap is complex. propose M2 = online + airgap bundle generator (packaging step only), M3 = full offline upgrade orchestration.
els: (ops-bot): note saved: /playbooks/private-deploy/airgap-guidance.md
raj: networking follow-up: need to support both pre-provisioned IP and dynamically allocated ranges. design decision: allow both; installer will accept either static cidr or allocate via customer API webhook.
elaine: security: ensure CMK rotate + rewrap flow tested during upgrade. add test case: rotate key mid-upgrade. owner: elaine. ETA: 2 weeks.
sanjay: compatibility matrix draft: runtime vX -> vY supported when config flags {enable_kv_migration:true, network_profile:compatible}. I'll add doc to PR.
mia: great. let's prioritize: 1) KMS/HSM path, 2) KV cache migration verification, 3) network-profile CLI + docs, 4) airgap bundle generator, 5) SLO + rollback checklist. Anyone want to reorder?
jamie: LGTM but swap 3 and 4 — docs for network-profile are quick, airgap packaging has more risk. put airgap resource buffer in schedule.
raj: noted. also need customer lab for on-prem hw variance (MTU, private DNS). request: get two customer lab environments for pilot.
customer-success: we can schedule pilot customers B and C for the week after staging tests. they signed NDAs.
mia: ok owners recap: sanjay (cache verifier), raj (network-profile CLI & lab), elaine (KMS tests), jamie (SLO + rollback), mia/product (pilot coordination + launch criteria doc), customer-success (pilot scheduling).
elaine: small ask — add a mandatory 'preflight' installer run that validates network, IP availability, and KMS reachability. failure should stop upgrade.
sanjay: implement preflight hooks in installer v2: --preflight-run.
mia: good. last: decide canary strategy — 10% of hosts for 24h vs staged by customer group. thoughts?
jamie: prefer staged by customer group for Private deployments (gives clear rollback boundary).
raj: agree. staged-by-customer. add metric: error-rate and token-latency per-customer post-upgrade.
customer-success: bringing this back to sales: we can market 'zero-downtime model serving' if we meet the SLOs.
mia: thanks. I'll write the launch criteria doc and PR the schedule. check-in sync Friday 10am. :thumbsup:
